verdict.rationale: First-party docs say tenant tokens are short-lived, scoped credentials generated from an API key. They embed filters that apply automatically to every search, so each user sees only their own data within a shared index, with no need for separate indexes per customer. The SaaS solution page and the comparison to Algolia secured keys and Postgres RLS reinforce this. The 2020 community note that tenant-filtered keys were not yet supported predates the documented feature and is not a current contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that tenant tokens work as documented.
